title: ManiCM: Real-time 3D Diffusion Policy via Consistency Model for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2406.01586v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have been verified to be effective in generating complex distributions from natural images to motion trajectories. Recent diffusion-based methods show impressive performance in 3D robotic manipulation tasks, whereas they suffer from severe runtime inefficiency due to multiple denoising steps, especially with high-dimensional observations. To this end, we propose a real-time robotic manipulation model named ManiCM that imposes the consistency constraint to the diffusion process, so that the model can generate robot actions in only one-step inference. Specifically, we formulate a consistent diffusion process in the robot action space conditioned on the point cloud input, where the original action is required to be directly denoised from any point along the ODE trajectory. translated_title: ManiCM：基于一致性模型的实时3D扩散策略用于机器人操作
translated_abstract: 摘要：扩散模型已被验证在从自然图像到运动轨迹的复杂分布生成中有效。近期基于扩散的方法在3D机器人操作任务中表现出色，但由于多次去噪步骤，尤其是在高维观测下，它们面临严重的运行效率低下问题。为此，我们提出了一种名为ManiCM的实时机器人操作模型，该模型对扩散过程施加一致性约束，使模型能够仅通过一步推理生成机器人动作。具体而言，我们在以点云输入为条件的机器人动作空间中构建了一个一致性扩散过程，其中原始动作需要直接从ODE轨迹上的任意点进行去噪。为建模此过程，我们设计了一种一致性蒸馏技术，直接预测动作样本，而非预测噪声。
tldr: 本文提出ManiCM，通过一致性约束和蒸馏技术实现一步推理的实时3D机器人操作扩散策略，显著提升推理速度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ManiCM, a real-time 3D diffusion policy for robotic manipulation that uses consistency constraints and distillation to enable one-step inference, significantly improving inference speed.
